newsitem.title: PORTUGAL: SOCCER-SWEDISH STRIKER PRINGLE SIGNS FOR BENFICA.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-SWEDISH STRIKER PRINGLE SIGNS FOR BENFICA.

text.p: Helsingborg's Swedish striker Martin Pringle signed a four-year contract on Friday with Portugal's Benfica after passing a series of medical tests.
Pringle, 25, will remain with Helsingborgs while the Swedish side remain in the UEFA Cup.
Helsingborgs play England's Aston Villa in the first round of the competition on September 10.
Benfica have not said how much they are paying for Pringle but according to local press reports, the transfer will cost the Lisbon side around 200 million escudos ($1.3 million).
